scope: Human-like visual observations by Codex, not a professional certification or exact palette validation.

items.notes: At 240 CSS px LUMA reads in four uppercase letters with open U/A counters. Revision a-v2 replaces the lowercase-like violet m with an uppercase M; coral L, gold U, teal A and horizontal balance remain. Rounded exterior corners and the M valley are visible. Inspected native full-size image and Chrome intended-size board. Exterior visually white; predefined corner probes contain near-white RGB 253–255 (up to 2 levels of channel variation), not exact #FFFFFF at every pixel. Original native bytes preserved.
